build_generalized_transformer: build a generalized ViT transformer from a variant string like 'base' or 'large'
create_transformer_from_spec: create a transformer with specified num_heads, num_layers, and mlp_size parameters
run_model_forward_pass: run a model forward pass on video input tensor and return transformer features
create_tokenizer: create a tokenizer that extracts patches from images and adds positional encodings
run_encoder_to_readout: run encoder-to-readout to reshape and resize intermediate transformer features
